IE00B4WXJG34:catalog:3.label: Rendement actuariel moyen (YTM/YTW)
IE00B4WXJG34:catalog:3.method: The discount rate that equates the present value of a bond’s cash flows with its market price (including accrued interest). The Fund Average Yield to Maturity is the weighted average of the fund’s individual bond holding yields based on Net Asset Value (‘NAV’). The measure does not include fees and expenses. For callable bonds, this yield is the yield-to-worst. For non-callable bonds the Yield to Maturity is equivalent to the yield-to-worst.

IE00B4WXJG34:catalog:4.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
IE00B4WXJG34:catalog:4.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

IE00BCRY6557:catalog:2.method: Weighted Average Maturity is the length of time until the average security in the fund will mature or be redeemed by its issuer. IE00BCRY6557:catalog:3.label: Rendement actuariel moyen (YTM/YTW)
IE00BCRY6557:catalog:3.method: The discount rate that equates the present value of a bond’s cash flows with its market price (including accrued interest). The Fund Average Yield to Maturity is the weighted average of the fund’s individual bond holding yields based on Net Asset Value (‘NAV’). The measure does not include fees and expenses. For callable bonds, this yield is the yield-to-worst. For non-callable bonds the Yield to Maturity is equivalent to the yield-to-worst.

IE00BCRY6557:catalog:4.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
IE00BCRY6557:catalog:4.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. IE00B1TXK627:catalog:1.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. IE00B1TXHL60:catalog:1.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
IE00B1TXHL60:catalog:1.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

IE00B3F81G20:catalog:1.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
IE00B3F81G20:catalog:1.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. IE00B2QWCY14:catalog:1.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
IE00B2QWCY14:catalog:1.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.

DE000A0Q4R02:catalog:1.label: Rendement des distributions sur 12 mois
DE000A0Q4R02:catalog:1.method: The yield an investor would have received if they had held the fund over the last twelve months assuming the most recent NAV. The 12-Month yield is calculated by assuming any income distributions over the past twelve months and dividing by the sum of the most recent NAV and any capital gain distributions made over the past twelve months. This yield calculation does not take into account any dividends received and held by the fund, but are awaiting the next distribution date. This can cause deviation with index level yield values.
